when: A shop opens after every blind that is played and beaten (not after skipped blinds).

layout.voucher_slots_note: +1 per Voucher Tag for that one shop
layout.first_shop_of_run: One of the two booster slots is guaranteed to be a normal Buffoon Pack.

reroll.resets: back to base cost at every new shop
reroll.formula: cost = base + rerolls_done_this_shop (base 5; 3 with Reroll Surplus; 1 with Reroll Glut)
reroll.what_changes: Only the card slots are replaced (2 new random cards); booster packs and the voucher are NOT rerolled. Not affected by Clearance Sale/Liquidation.

card_slot_weights.rule: Each card slot picks a type with probability weight/sum(weights), then a card of that type.
card_slot_weights.playing_cards: Plain cards (random rank & suit) for $1 without Illusion. With Illusion: 40% Enhanced, 20% edition (Poly 15/Holo 35/Foil 50), no seals (bug).
card_slot_weights.spectral_in_shop: Ghost Deck only; The Soul and Black Hole never appear in the shop.

joker_generation.rarity_roll: r uniform: r > 0.95 -> Rare, r > 0.7 -> Uncommon, else Common. Legendary only via The Soul.
joker_generation.within_rarity: uniform among unlocked jokers of that rarity that are not already owned/shown (unless Showman) and whose spawn condition holds (e.g. enhancement-based jokers need that enhancement in the deck; see jokers data).
joker_generation.fallback: If a pool is empty the game gives the default card: Joker -> 'Joker', Tarot -> Strength, Planet -> Pluto, Spectral -> Incantation, Voucher -> Blank.
joker_generation.editions: see modifiers.json appearance_rates.jokers_shop_and_packs (base: Negative 0.3%, Poly 0.3%, Holo 1.4%, Foil 2%; Hone x2 / Glow Up x4 on Foil/Holo/Poly thresholds)
joker_generation.stickers: see stakes.json sticker_rules (shop and Buffoon-pack jokers only)
joker_generation.duplicates: No duplicate of a joker/consumable already owned, in the shop, or in the open pack unless Showman is owned.

base_costs.Joker: per joker (Common $1-6, Uncommon $4-8, Rare $7-10, Legendary $20) - see jokers.json

prices.buy_formula: buy = max(1, floor((base_cost + edition_surcharge + inflation + 0.5) * (100 - discount_percent) / 100)); i.e. discount then round half DOWN (8.5 -> 8), minimum $1.
special_cases: Astronomer joker: Planet cards and Celestial packs cost $0.
Coupon Tag: initial cards and packs of the next shop cost $0 (not vouchers, not rerolled cards).
Edition tags (Foil/Holo/Poly/Negative) and Uncommon/Rare tags: the affected joker is free.
Inflation is a challenge-only modifier (+$1 to all prices per purchase); 0 in normal runs.
prices.sell_formula: sell = max(1, floor(buy / 2)) + extra_sell_value, where buy is recomputed with current discounts (so Clearance/Liquidation also lower sell values).

sell_growth.Egg: +$3 to its own extra sell value at end of each round
sell_growth.Gift Card: +$1 extra sell value to every joker and consumable at end of each round
sell_growth.note: extra sell value is added after halving and is not discounted

rules: Two booster slots per shop, each rolled independently by weight (same pack can appear twice). Packs do not restock on reroll; buying one opens it immediately.

Weights below are per pack kind (the game splits them over art variants: Normal Arcana/Celestial/Standard have 4 variants of weight 1, Jumbo 2 of weight 1, Mega 2 of weight 0.25; Normal Buffoon 2 x 0.6, Jumbo 1 x 0.6, Mega 1 x 0.15; Normal Spectral 2 x 0.3, Jumbo 1 x 0.3, Mega 1 x 0.07).
A pack always shows the full card count. Normal/Jumbo: pick 1; Mega: pick up to 2. Skipping is allowed at any time.
Arcana and Spectral packs deal a hand of playing cards (current hand size) to target; held consumables may be used inside a pack.
Arcana: Tarots; each card 0.3% chance to be The Soul; with Omen Globe each card 20% chance to be a Spectral instead (which can itself be The Soul/Black Hole).
Celestial: Planets; each card 0.3% chance to be Black Hole; with Telescope one card is the Planet of your most played hand.
Spectral: Spectral cards; each card 0.3% chance to be The Soul and 0.3% to be Black Hole.
Standard: playing cards with random rank/suit; 40% Enhanced (uniform over 8), 20% Seal (uniform over 4), editions Poly 1.2% / Holo 2.8% / Foil 4% (x2 Hone, x4 Glow Up), never Negative.
Buffoon: jokers with normal rarity weights (70/25/5), editions and stake stickers like the shop.
Tags give free Mega Standard/Arcana/Celestial/Buffoon packs and a free normal Spectral pack (Ethereal).
